source: Written for AWS City. Facts in the lines follow AWS's docs (S3 durability 11 nines, Lambda pay-per-use, Multi-AZ standby, least privilege).

any: I just learned about IAM roles!
My bucket has versioning on. Sleeping well.
Tag everything. Future you says thanks.
Who left that server running all weekend?
Encrypt it before you forget it.
Small changes, often. That's the way.
I read a Well-Architected tip today!
morning: Early bird gets the first look at last night's alarms.
Good morning! Backups ran overnight, all green.
evening: Long day. Did the deploy go out?
Time to scale in and head home.
Evening! Remember to stop the test servers.
Dinner at the Lambda Food Stall?
night: Night shift. The alarms will wake us if anything breaks.
The city never sleeps, but the dev servers should.
Quiet night. Just the backups humming.
findings: A citizen found a problem. Shall we look?
Someone left something open, I heard.
There's a warning cone up. Better check it.
outage: AWS says a Region is having trouble. Glad our backups are elsewhere.
Storm over town. Good thing we're in more than one zone.
Is the dashboard red? Check the AWS Health line.
This is why we practise failover.
Hope everyone copied their data to a second Region.
drill: It's only a practice drill. Stay calm and fail over!
Drill day! Watch the other zones keep serving.
grown: Look how big the city's got!
New flats on our street. The city's growing.
More shops every week. Business is good.
Remember when this was all empty lots?

ambient: New file in your bucket? Ring my bell and I will cook it.
Cleo, can you keep copies of these photos near the users (cache them)?
Which part of the garden (subnet) should my new factory go in?
Your badge only lets you read S3. Nothing else!
Card filed. Ask for it by the user’s number (userId) any time.
Storm on the horizon. Keep the post offices at the edge ready.
Visitors to www get sent to you now.
Rex, what is in this picture?
Your files are locked with the city’s key (alias/city).
I trained my own model. Want to compare notes?
Aurora, how do you keep six copies so tidy?
Every container can drink from my well at once.
Need more ships for these containers.
Luke, anything new on the user’s screen?
Your error count went up at noon. Want the logs?
Twelve messages waiting. Take them in batches?
Order placed! Passing it along the bus.
Someone tried a key from far away. Worth a look.
This visitor signed in. Here's their token.
Request at the front door. Your turn.
Six copies across three zones. Practice, Ray.
I'll remember that answer, so you don't have to look it up again.
Scanning only the columns I need. Cheaper that way.
Bring me the cleaned tables tonight, please.
Who knows whom? That's a question for my web.
Copied out every form field. Saving them now.
My agent remembers the last conversation now.
Private subnet for you. No doors to the internet.
Your locker's snapshot is done. Safe across the Region.
Planting two more servers for the lunch rush.
No ships needed. I'll carry the containers myself.
The scheduler found room for three more pods on your nodes.
